{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the data
print(data.dtypes)
print(data.head())

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
# First, check for the QA orders
print("\nQA orders (revenue = 999999.99):", data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99'].shape[0])

# Clean revenue: remove commas and cast to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Drop QA orders
data_clean = data[data['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Drop refunded orders
data_clean = data_clean[data_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Confirm the data is clean
print(f"\nFinal dataset shape: {data_clean.shape}")

# Check channel distribution
print(f"\nChannel distribution:\n{data_clean['channel'].value_counts()}")

# Check customer_segment distribution by channel
print(f"\nCustomer segment by channel:\n{pd.crosstab(data_clean['channel'], data_clean['customer_segment'])}")

# Compute conversion rates by channel
conversion_rates = data_clean.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print(f"\nConversion rates by channel:\n{conversion_rates}")

# Compute difference (email - paid_search)
diff = conversion_rates['email'] - conversion_rates['paid_search']
print(f"\nDifference (email - paid_search): {diff}")"}
